author: gpt-5.6-luna
kind: a folder of inputs for a new program: three teams' current tool inventories (CSV), their roadmaps (md), a ticket export of open requests (CSV, 80 to 120 tickets), headcount sheet and a leadership memo
scenario: Leadership wants one shared deployment tool instead of three. The director asks the TPM: frame this as a program I can take to the staff meeting: what problem we solve, the workstreams, what each depends on, the first milestones, and what we do not know yet.
seeds: (1) two teams' roadmaps both claim to own the same migration in the same quarter; (2) a hidden shared dependency (an auth or secrets service) that all workstreams need and that has one owner; (3) the headcount sheet shows a gap of a specific number of engineers against the memo's ask; (4) one team's tool has a compliance requirement (audit log retention) the others do not, which constrains the choice; (5) a decoy: a request with many votes that is out of scope per the memo.
shape: {"problem": str, "workstreams": [{"name": str, "teams": [str], "depends_on": [names or ids]}], "shared_dependencies": [names], "conflicts": [{"between": [teams], "about": str}], "headcount_gap": n, "constraints": [str], "milestones": [{"name": str, "date": "YYYY-MM-DD"}], "open_questions": [str], "out_of_scope": [ids]}
